name: peckboard-project-planner
description: PeckBoard plugin: an interview-style slideshow that builds a project definition file. An agent session asks one pointed question per slide — fill-in-the-blank or justified multiple choice, with diagrams — and writes each answer into PROJECT_DEFINITION.md as a requirement.

scripts.build: node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
